findings.title: applyMergePatch result shares nested values with the target
findings.why: The doc comment says neither argument is modified. Target members are copied into the result by reference with `setMember(result, key, target[key])`. A key that the patch does not touch therefore keeps the same nested object or array. For example, `mp({a:{b:1}}, {c:1}).a` is the very object `target.a`, so mutating the result changes the caller's target. `applyPatch` and `createPatch` both deep-clone, and the merge-patch test only checks aliasing of the patch, not of the target.

findings.title: isObject and setMember duplicated from patch.ts
findings.why: Both helpers are copied verbatim from `src/patch.ts`, where `isObject` is already exported. `diff.ts` imports it from there. The two copies can drift apart.

findings.title: addValueReplacing is misnamed and defined after its use
findings.why: The function only overwrites an existing member. It sits below `applyPatch`, away from the other helpers (`addValue`, `removeValue`). A name such as `replaceValue`, placed next to them, would match the others.
